A brand new month is here, and so is our May update — bringing you even more fun and adventure! 🌼⚔️
As the days get warmer, exciting new content and special events await to keep your SoulSaver journey  full of energy and surprises.

3rd party macro programs. Note: It only applies to the ban cause of macro programs only. Other causes including cheat/hack program usage,
illegal trade, account trade/selling, and in game bug exploitation is not eligible for amnesty in this event.


Amnesty event period : Until May 31st, 2025
How to : submit a ticket on the website including the following details(Information will only be used for verification)

- Account name

- Your full name(Registered name)

- 1st registered email address of the account

- An ID card that shows your identity.


After receiving the tickets, we will evaluate and release the account if it meets the criteria.
**The accounts released on this amnesty event will immediately be banned permanently if similar activities are detected.

notes.title: [Info] Update Note for 16th of April
notes.content:
Hello Savers!





Get ready for the upcoming April update, packed with fresh content and exciting improvements. 🌸✨

As the season blossoms, we’re bringing you new events to make your SoulSaver adventure even more enjoyable.



Breathe in the spring vibes and stay tuned for more thrilling journeys!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We have received reports that, following the latest patch, some users’ antivirus software (particularly Windows Defender) is
detecting our game’s executable file (game.exe) as Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml. After careful investigation, we have
confirmed that this is a false positive and that our game files are safe. We have taken all necessary measures,
including digital signing and file encryption, but occasionally Windows Defender may still flag the file incorrectly.

If you are encountering this issue, we recommend one of the following solutions:

1. Add an Exception in Windows Defender
Open Windows Defender settings and select “Virus & threat protection.”
Under “Protection history,” locate the quarantined file and allow it.
Alternatively, add the game.exe file to the “Exclusions” list.

2. Use a Different Antivirus Program
If you prefer, you can install another reputable antivirus solution.
Temporarily disable Windows Defender to prevent further false detections.

We understand this situation may be frustrating, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Thank you for your patience and continued support.

If you have any additional questions or concerns, please contact our support team.



[Scheduled Server Update]

Date/Time: 16th of April 09:00 ~ 14:00 [GMT + 9]

notes.title: [Info] Update Note for 24th of October
notes.content:
Hello, Savers!

 
On this month's update, we have brought up some measures that will prevent auto-farming/leveling with 3rd party programs.

Over the last decade, we have seen that many of you have been using macro programs, cheat programs, vmware programs, and remote-access programs to play the game automatically, or to play multiple account at the same time. The usage of these programs has harmed every player's fair gameplay. Therefore, we are announcing as of October 18th, 2023, we will be strictly banning the accounts that use any kind of macro, cheat, vmware, and  remote-access programs.

 
Starting on that day, The accounts that have used cheat programs will be banned instantly, and permanently.
For the accounts that have used macro or vmware programs, we have decided to give yout 2 chances. The first usage will result in 1 30-day block, and the second usage will lead to a permanent block.
We ask you to please follow the user agreement that you have agreed on upon account creation, and maintain fair gameplay.

And for the final announcement, we will be holding an amnesty event ending on the last day of October, 2023. If your account was blocked for the usage of a macro-like program, please submit a ticket via SoulSaver website. We will review your accounts  and unblock for the last time. Also, keep in mind that these unblocked accounts will not have 2 chances. If a program is detected again, the accounts will be permanently banned again.

All other accounts that were banned for the reason other than macro-like programs will not be alegible for release. The tickets submitted for these accounts will strictly be ignored.

Starting today, we hope that the players and the staff together can make the game more enjoyable.

 
We have an important announcement to make. We've observed that several users of the Mamluk class have been exploiting a particular game bug. Under normal circumstances, this bug should not manifest. Consequently, we categorize players who exploit this Mamluk bug as violators of our program's terms of use. We urge you to refrain from such actions to avoid potential server restrictions or bans.

Thank you for the love you have given to SoulSaver.

Best Regards,
SoulSaver Team

For more information, please visit:

notes.title: [Bug] Bug after Update for August
notes.content:
Hello, Savers!

 

We have found few bugs after this update.
Bugs stated below will be fixed in near future.

 

1. Display Error for TaehwaChest

 Currently TaehwaChests show Black Knight Set instead of White Knight Set.
 As you may see from its lacking translation, the set has not released on GSP server.
Even each Tawhwachest's item list shows Black Knight Set,  players will receive White Knight Set.
[Drop rate is also the same as previous patch version.]
     

2. AllSkillResetAmulet Error 
This item is currently unavaliable to use with message "Item with no Property value"

We assume that there is something to do with fishingRod players use.


We apologize for the inconvenience.

GOM

notes.content:
Hello, Savers!

Many Savers have been waiting for some intriguing contents for a long time and 
finally, it is our pleasure to introduce new class, Mamluk.

We are focused on providing infinity aids for newbie Mamluk Savers. So, do not miss out this good 
opportunity to start new class without much burden on ingame capital.

Before announcing about update contents for this month...

notes.content:
Hello, Savers!


There are couple things GM wants to mention before announcing contents about November Update.
Soul Saver Online had a sharp increase in user pool recently. GM believes that New & Come-back users have moved from Thailand server. GOM is really glad to provide them with game service and support.
However, it seems that many new players are using 3rd party programs all around the map. 
As many innocent players have requested, GM will mainly focus on blocking all cheat players and their cheat programs.

Furthermore, Require Level for using Ghost shop on Steam client will be set from 100 to 80.

Yes, theme for this update is Thanksgiving and "Combo System" will also be added from this update.
Please note that "Combo System" has not even coming out on Korean Ghost Online.

Hope you have great Thanksgiving Day!

notes.title: [Update] Update Note for 24th of August
notes.content:
Hello, Savers!

 

It seems that summer vacations almost end and new school year is coming close.

We hope that all Savers are well-prepared for back to school and have a great

achievement on school-work this year

 

Finally, here is exciting announcements for which many Savers waited.

Soul Saver Online is going to have August contents update celebrating back to school.

Awesome school-look costumes will be temporary released on ghost shop and

new event quest will be added too.

Of course, we have concentrated on fixing ingame errors and stabilizing server on this update.

 

Moreover, it would be possible for Steam users to participate in "Daily Attendance Event"

after update on September.

Explain reason why Steam users are unable to participate in current attendance event, 

"Reach Level" and Attendance Event" are currently offering via web verification, which means,

those who have created account on SSO website can participate in the events.

To fix such issue, we have decided to change the format of attendance event.

Players will have to participate in events through ingame NPC, not web verification.

 

For more information on the format of event, we will post it on notice in the future.

  

 

[Scheduled server update] 

Date/ Time : 24th of August 09:00 AM- 12:00 PM. [GMT +9:00]
